name: Utility communication system
description: Utility communication system for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: SESB GSO/User operational liaison and  — communication channel establishment
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC5.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): full paragraph on operational liaison terms and communication channels. (value: GSO and Users nominate persons/contact locations and agree communication channel)

specifications.metric: SESB GSO/User operational liaison and  — technical criteria source for voice and data communication
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code CC5.5 'Technical Criteria for Communication Equipment' (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'The technical criteria concerning voice and data communication equipment for Power Stations is contained in the Grid Owner's guidelines document, which is available on request.' (value: Grid Owner's guidelines document, available on request)

specifications.metric: SESB GSO/User operational liaison and  — telecommunication signalling in fault clearance time
specifications.unit: 7.5 cycles (150 ms) for 132 kV overhead lines
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code CC5.6/protection criteria (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Total fault clearance times include time for relay operation, circuit breaker operation, and telecommunication signaling ... for the 132 kV lines, 7.5 cycles (150 ms)'.

specifications.metric: SESB GSO/User operational liaison and  — metering communication equipment legal approval
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code MC6.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai). (value: must be approved under relevant telecommunication laws and regulations)

specifications.metric: CAT-1 remote monitor / CATMaster s — nominal radio range
specifications.basis: Google Patents US8738191B2 page read 25 Nov 2026; description as printed: 'Radio range is nominally 20 km, but varies with local conditions (e.g. terrain). Solar powered spread spectrum radio repeaters are available for longer communication distances.' Publication date 2014-05-27, priority 2010-09-17. No price in document.

specifications.metric: CAT-1 remote monitor / CATMaster s — data points per CAT-1 programmed into SCADA
specifications.basis: Google Patents US8738191B2 page read 25 Nov 2026: 'Data point definitions (12 per CAT-1) are then programmed into SCADA. Radio path and signal strengths are then verified. Receipt of 12 bi-polar analog data points per CAT-1 is also verified.' No price in document.

specifications.metric: CAT-1 remote monitor / CATMaster s — remote monitors handled per CATMaster
specifications.basis: Google Patents US8738191B2 page read 25 Nov 2026: 'The CATMaster is a 19 inch (483 mm) rack-mount unit that acquires data from up to four CAT-1 Remote Monitors via a spread spectrum radio transceiver.' No price in document.
